title: Compatible homotopy equivalences are invertible in an enriched pullback along a local fibration
statement: Use simplicial sets, weak homotopy equivalences and Kan fibrations from [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set] and [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper]. A small simplicial category has a set of objects, simplicial mapping sets, and associative unital simplicial composition. Its category $\pi_0$ has components of mapping sets as morphisms. Let $p:A\to B$ and $q:C\to B$ be simplicial functors, and assume that $A(a,a')\to B(pa,pa')$ is a Kan fibration for every pair $a,a'$. Form the strict pullback simplicial category $E=A\times_B C$: objects are pairs $(a,c)$ with $pa=qc$, and mapping sets are the corresponding strict pullbacks of mapping simplicial sets. A vertex $u$ in a mapping set of $E$ is invertible in $\pi_0E$ if and only if its projections are invertible in $\pi_0A$ and $\pi_0C$. No mapping set is assumed Kan, and neither functor is assumed to lift equivalences on objects.
